signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a split-level house frontage, partly screened by large trees in the foreground.

yard_sign.detail: A small sign and a wooden placard sit near the front walkway, but they are too small to read and may be decorative or a security sign.

signals.notes: The lawn is green and edged with a fieldstone border. There is a mulched bed with a lawn ornament, and a newly staked tree with a watering bag on the right. Several cars are parked to the right of the house, but it is unclear whether they belong to this property or a neighbor.
